scope: Targeted New Zealand calendar API restoration and Australian official broadcast-schedule follow-up; not a survey of all Oceania sources.

current_house_status_probe.response_encoding: JSON string containing a JSON object

whole_2026_house_array.purpose: Bounded schema discovery, not the production collection window or current programmes.

general_august_events.decision: Do not route the generic mixed committee/House endpoint into the House catalogue channel.

other_schema_probes.date_format: ISO yyyy-MM-dd requests return arrays. A tested dd-MM-yyyy request returned HTTP400 and is not used; that format also occurs in client UI resources but is not the API query contract.

confirmed: The former Azure HTML calendar endpoint still returns a Blazor loading shell for direct collection.
The canonical human calendar is bot-protected for this direct client. No challenge was solved and no credential/session bypass was used.
The published Blazor boot manifest declares the client assemblies; their public string tables expose the exact calendar API routes.

The House-only endpoint returns a JSON event array with public UUID, source date, title, start/end clocks and meetingType2. The generic events endpoint also contains type1 committee meetings and is not used.
The bounded current window genuinely returns an empty array; the independent public House-status message reports no current/next sitting and null next date.
A bounded historic production-shaped request returns three House events with three official IDs, official URLs and explicit time ranges; normal collection and quality assessment succeed.
Source wall clocks use Pacific/Auckland; clocks are converted to UTC with DST gaps/folds rejected, and unknown ends remain unknown.
unresolved: The source is an institutional sitting calendar rather than a verified uninterrupted linear programme grid. The API normal-sitting envelope can span the dinner break documented by the official sitting programme.
No exact on-air feed identity or between-sitting replay programme schedule is established, so no LINEAR_GUIDE allowlist admission is added.
No upcoming timed House sitting is currently provided; the restored collector adds a healthy empty result rather than manufacturing programmes.
new_zealand.runtime_change: Use a dated House-only JSON request and strict network response validation; preserve existing saved legacy HTML parse compatibility and clear protection/loading errors.

australia.direct_client_result: HTTP403 for current public watch/read/listen route; the web retrieval tool also reports access/robots limits.
australia.official_indexed_context: Official Watch/Read/Listen results expose dated simultaneous House, Senate, Federation Chamber, committee and press-event schedules, but sampled search renderings are September data and do not prove the current October window.
confirmed: The catalogue already uses the generic official YouTube-live metadata collector.
An institutional multi-room broadcast directory cannot be assumed to be a single linear YouTube programme feed.
unresolved: Supported current machine-retrievable schedule payload and its date-window contract.
Exact event/chamber-to-published-feed mapping for concurrent proceedings.
australia.decision: No new Australian parser, mapping or guessed programme times added from blocked or stale indexed content.

verification.full_repo_checks: Root integration step; old SOURCE URL assertion and canonical EPG URL/kind need updating.

privacy.challenge_redirects: Only protection classification is retained; raw signed/tokenized redirect URLs are omitted.
